1ac44811-8c9d-43a6-979f-d1aeb1211a41.title: Coldcard Vulnerability and Wallet Entropy Best Practices
1ac44811-8c9d-43a6-979f-d1aeb1211a41.author: mrrgnome (MrRGnome)
1ac44811-8c9d-43a6-979f-d1aeb1211a41.line1: There is a severe vulnerability you may presume is **affecting all coldcards initialized after 2020** regardless of model.
1ac44811-8c9d-43a6-979f-d1aeb1211a41.line2: Some models have more severe problems than others (mk3) but even newer models have effectively 72 bits of entropy instead of the desired 256.
